facts.business: S V Global Mill Limited operates in the Real Estate business, while its subsidiary SV Global Finance Private Limited operates as a non-deposit taking NBFC engaged in lending.

auditor.name: M/s. SENTHIL KUMAR & SUNDARARAJAN, Chartered Accountants (Firm Registration Number: 011750S)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: The company's case for additional compensation pertaining to compulsory acquired land pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India was disposed off vide final judgement order dated 9th Feb 2026 and remanded back to the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka, which referred the case to Karnataka Mediation Centre on 6th April 2026.

key_risks: Diminution in value of investments leading to losses in subsidiary
Litigation risk regarding land acquisition compensation case pending in courts
Market risk and interest rate risk (though company has no foreign currency exposure or borrowings)
facts.related_party_note: Subsidiary: SV Global Finance Private Limited (99.99% ownership). Associate: Adyar Property Holdings Private Limited (25.31% ownership). Capital advance pursuant to scheme of demerger of erstwhile Binny Limited involving Padmadevi Sugars Ltd.
